primary_sources.title: KBVQ-MoE: KLT-guided SVD with Bias-Corrected Vector Quantization for MoE Large Language Models

primary_sources.observation_at_seal: The author repository contains a README and paper PDF but no executable implementation; the gate follows the camera-ready equations rather than third-party code.

raw_mse_specialization.paper_objective: sum_i Tr(E_i C_X E_i^T) = sum_i ||E_i U_X||_F^2
raw_mse_specialization.specialization: For unweighted raw weight MSE, C_X is the identity and U_X is the identity. IDRE therefore reduces exactly to a right singular subspace of the stacked raw canonical weights.
raw_mse_specialization.BCOS_reason: BCOS corrects activation-output moments and is not evidence for unweighted raw source-coordinate MSE.

architecture.name: IDRE-RMSE-FP16

paper_faithful_role_specific.fit: For each role r, form G_r = sum_fit W_(e,r)^T W_(e,r) and take the leading k eigenvectors B_r.
paper_faithful_role_specific.serialization: one FP16 B_r per role shared over 128 experts; one FP16 A_(e,r) per expert and role

favorable_joint_role_extension.fit: Pool canonical Up and Down rows into one Gram matrix and take one leading right basis B.
favorable_joint_role_extension.private_factor: one A_(e,r) per expert and role
favorable_joint_role_extension.purpose: A more read-efficient strict superset-like control for the shared-axis hypothesis; it is more favorable than the paper's separate-role basis in shared bytes.

architecture.residual_quantizer_at_gate: ideal continuous Gaussian residual channel using every byte left by the fixed container
architecture.exact_free_envelope: Before any FP16/header/rate penalty, grant the selected low-rank component exact and free. The resulting q=1-capture and s=-0.5log2(q) are gross capture diagnostics only, not physical F scores, because a physical design must charge the factors and redistribute the remaining bits over fewer residual dimensions.
architecture.physical_two_role_gate: Charge the exact shared/private/header byte layout, grant FP16 factor rounding error zero, assign zero residual bits to captured dimensions, and solve the exact Gaussian reverse-waterfill between the Up and Down residual bands using every remaining payload bit.
architecture.coordinated_refinement: If requested, independently replay the payload and solve a finer exact diagonal-Gaussian reverse-waterfill over every fitted residual right mode.
architecture.nested_rank_monotonicity: Leading eigenspaces are nested only within a fitted IDRE mode. This property bounds gross capture at smaller ranks; it neither supplies a physical rate allocation nor establishes containment/disjointness with any composite codec.

distinct_from_existing.difference: That oracle projects a flattened held-out whole matrix onto whole-matrix templates using one scalar per template. IDRE uses a shared 2048-coordinate right basis and 768 private coefficients per rank, per role and expert.

That gate transforms and quantizes both the selected subspace and its complement; it charges a basis but not IDRE's FP16 expert-private low-rank factors. IDRE instead retains a decoded low-rank component and quantizes only its residual. The prior gate nevertheless contains the exact held-out projection energies needed for a free-component upper bound.
FABRIC applies a full-rank axis transform and reverse-waterfills all modes. It does not serialize an FP16 subtractive low-rank component before residual quantization.

container.emitted_rule: shared_packet_bytes + 128*expert_frame_bytes; unused cap remainder is not emitted
container.cold_byte_rule: union of the complete shared packet and one contiguous expert frame
container.cold_page_rule: exact union of 4-KiB pages touched by those two byte ranges for every possible expert-frame offset; use the worst expert

prior_sufficient_statistic.reason_reusable: The prior artifact used the identical fit/validation split, canonical shapes, joint/role-specific leading right bases, and reports exact held-out source and projected energies through rank 256.

frozen_decision.free_capture_warning: The free rank-256 values are not the decision statistic and must not be compared to physical F without a rate allocation.
frozen_decision.decision_scope: Exact two-role Gaussian residual waterfill from authenticated aggregate energies, with literal factor/header bytes and zero FP16 factor error. This is not a per-mode residual converse.

composite_nesting.reason: The gross free sum would cross the target but ignores factor bytes, violates the rank/read envelope, uses a different auxiliary sample, and may remove the same source energy as the existing role/polar composite. A valid nesting experiment must apply IDRE to the literal decoded-composite residual and redo one joint physical bit allocation. Rank monotonicity does not establish containment or disjointness.

execution_interlock.default_mode: rederive the prior sufficient-statistic proof without importing CuPy or opening numeric Qwen payloads

claim_boundary: This kills the tested KBVQ-IDRE cell under the declared two-role diagonal-Gaussian residual model for held-out auxiliary Qwen raw weight MSE and the stated FP16/read architecture. It is not yet an exact per-mode residual converse and has no additive-gain or containment relationship with the existing composite. It does not refute activation-weighted output error, BCOS, nonlinear shared decoders, model-quality gains, or a basis learned from a materially different signal.
